stories.title: A la caza del feminicida de Cuautla en la noche del Grito de Independencia en México

en.title: Hunting for the femicide perpetrator in Cuautla on Mexico's Independence Day night
en.summary: Mexican authorities are searching for the suspected killer of Claudia Tacoronte as her colleagues protest against violence in the country during Independence Day celebrations.

stories.title: Cumplir 18 años en un centro de menores: “Me trajeron una tarta, pero ni siquiera la probé”

en.title: Turning 18 in a youth detention center: "They brought me a cake, but I didn't even taste it"
en.summary: Unaccompanied minors transferred from Ceuta to mainland Spain face abrupt changes in their circumstances upon reaching adulthood in care facilities.

stories.title: Urtasun evita asumir un plan nacional frente a la oleada de robos en museos

en.title: Urtasun avoids committing to a national plan against the wave of museum thefts
en.summary: Spain's Culture Minister declines to commit to national security protocols or additional funding following the theft of the Villena treasure and other recent museum robberies.

stories.title: PISA iguala por abajo: los alumnos ricos caen más pero los pobres también se hunden

en.title: PISA equalizes downward: wealthy students fall more but poor students also sink
en.summary: The global PISA report reveals that student performance among wealthier populations has declined more than among lower-income groups, narrowing the socioeconomic achievement gap in Spain.

stories.title: La espiral de engaños de Iván y sus secuaces para adquirir casas de ancianos a precios ridículos

en.title: The spiral of deceptions by Iván and his accomplices to acquire elderly care homes at ridiculous prices
en.summary: A criminal scheme targets elderly people through a multi-phase con operation, beginning with well-dressed young men presenting themselves as salespeople for unnecessary products to gain the trust of vulnerable seniors.

stories.title: Messi tendrá su último baile con Argentina en un partido amistoso

en.title: Messi will have his final dance with Argentina in a friendly match
en.summary: Argentina announced its squad for three upcoming friendlies, with Inter Miami footballer Leo Messi included to play only in the last match on October 6.

stories.title: La escuela española sí iguala por abajo: los alumnos excelentes empeoran más del doble que los rezagados

en.title: Spanish schools do equalize downward: excellent students decline more than twice as much as struggling ones
en.summary: A significant gap between native and immigrant students has doubled in three years, with wealthy students' performance declining notably more than lower-performing peers across Spanish regions.

stories.title: La oleada de robos más rápidos y violentos que amenaza a los museos de Europa: "Hoy pueden llevarse arte, mañana iPhones y al siguiente coches de alta gama"

en.title: The wave of faster and more violent thefts threatening European museums: "Today they can steal art, tomorrow iPhones and the next day high-end cars"
en.summary: Museums across Spain, Italy, the United Kingdom, Austria, and France have faced a recent surge of rapid, violent robbery attacks on their collections.

stories.title: Messi bailará su 'ultimo tango' con Argentina el próximo octubre en un amistoso ante Benín

en.title: Messi will dance his 'last tango' with Argentina next October in a friendly against Benin
en.summary: The Argentine Football Federation announced a friendly match against Benin scheduled for October that will serve as a tribute to former Barcelona player Messi.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran se defiende tras la expulsión del rapero Macklemore de su gira por apoyar a Palestina: "El sufrimiento y el dolor causado en los dos bandos es una tragedia humana"

en.title: Ed Sheeran defends himself after rapper Macklemore expelled from his tour for supporting Palestine: "Suffering and pain on both sides is a human tragedy"
en.summary: Rapper Macklemore was removed from Ed Sheeran's tour for his Palestine support statements. Sheeran stated the decision was made solely by the tour promoters and acknowledged suffering exists on both sides.

stories.title: Una estafa masiva y “sin escrúpulos” a ancianos para quedarse con sus casas: “Se quitaban de comer para pagar la deuda”

en.title: Massive and "unscrupulous" scam targeting elderly people to seize their homes: "They went without food to pay the debt"
en.summary: Authorities dismantled a criminal organization that targeted elderly people by posing as appliance salespeople and ultimately gained ownership of their properties.

stories.title: Expulsado el rapero Macklemore de la gira de Ed Sheeran por su apoyo a Palestina

en.title: Rapper Macklemore expelled from Ed Sheeran tour for his support of Palestine
en.summary: Robert Kraft, owner of the New England Patriots, banned the American artist from concerts in Boston due to his Palestinian advocacy.

stories.title: La inflación de los combustibles sube un 46% y mete presión al Gobierno para reactivar ayudas

en.title: Fuel inflation rises 46% and puts pressure on Government to reactivate subsidies
en.summary: Consumer prices accelerated to 4.3% in August driven by energy cost increases, with diesel rising 30.3%, gasoline 16.9%, and electricity 9.2%.

stories.title: La española Fever se valora en más de 4.500 millones

en.title: Spanish Fever valued at over 4,500 million
en.summary: Vitruvian acquired a 5% stake in Atresmedia's Spanish technology company Fever for 227 million euros. Fever is completing a funding round that will include participation from EQT.

stories.title: El Ibex 35 rinde más por dividendos que el bono español a 10 años

en.title: Ibex 35 yields more from dividends than Spanish 10-year bond
en.summary: The Ibex 35 index offers a higher dividend yield than the return on Spain's 10-year government bonds, supported by banking and energy stocks.

stories.title: Mañana en EXPANSIÓN TecnologIA, todas las claves del debate que sacude la inteligencia artificial

en.title: Tomorrow in EXPANSIÓN Technology, all the keys to the debate shaking artificial intelligence
en.summary: An upcoming supplement will cover the questions, answers, and main players shaping the century's technological battle over artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Javier Echave deja Heathrow tras 18 años para fichar por Merlin Properties

en.title: Javier Echave leaves Heathrow after 18 years to join Merlin Properties
en.summary: An executive is returning to Spain to take charge of the finance department at Ibex-listed real estate company Merlin Properties during its data center expansion.
